_comment: Server-charged: the press opens the attempt, the release payload ends it, and ApparitionChargeManager owns the tick counter and the Deliberation window. input.chargeTicks is kept only to drive the client-side charge-up ring, set to BLINK's chargeDuration so the ring completes as the window opens. cooldownTicks is 0 because ApparitionServerLogic stamps the per-tier cooldown itself.
